entities.name: Ehsan
entities.description: Young Fallaji soldier, no older than fourteen, who fought for Mishra in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader on whose side the Fallaji fought.

entities.name: Farid
entities.description: Veteran Fallaji soldier who advised Ehsan to stay close.

entities.name: Karrak
entities.description: Veteran Fallaji soldier who found Laria's chocolate and note.

entities.name: Laria
entities.description: Argivian soldier who left a note of gratitude with chocolate.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Campaign of 44 AR in which Ehsan fought.

events.summary: Ehsan is chosen as a fourth member for a covert patrol to trade with the enemy.
events.quote: He was selected by Farid , Karrak , and Aiman for a covert operation

events.summary: The group meets Argivian soldiers and learns crucial information about the upcoming battle.
events.quote: During the meeting with the Argivian soldiers, Ehsan was mostly silent

events.summary: Ehsan joins the final wave of D Company, Third Tomakul Spears, and takes Farid's advice to stay close.
events.quote: Ehsan was nervous but took Farid's advice to heart

events.summary: They cross no-man's-land and find the Argivian trench deserted.
events.quote: They reached the Argivian trench to find it deserted

events.summary: Karrak finds a packet with chocolate and a note of gratitude from Laria.
events.quote: Karrak discovered a packet containing a small piece of chocolate

relations.quote: Ehsan was a Fallaji soldier who fought on the side of Mishra
